author: PC Gamer
text:
Count Binface threatens to nationalize Sega if it doesn't come across with a Shenmue 4 update
The UK's most famous novelty politician took time out from his campaign against Nigel Farage to address a real national problem.

author: PC Gamer
text:
Union claims Bethesda developers 'received termination letters' the day Xbox announced new Fallouts—after being told they would still have jobs until September
The OneBGS union says it's filed new legal action over the dismissal.

author: PC Gamer
text:
Steam update makes gifting much easier, adds wishlist organization features
Aunts and uncles rejoice: Sending gifts on Steam has been simplified.

author: PC Gamer
text:
Blizzard is investigating a World of Warcraft cheating scandal after game master 'death-touched' bosses for friends without realizing it was being recorded
One of the players then went on a Twitch stream to spill the beans.

author: PC Gamer
text:
Indie game gets last minute Steam delay while Valve reviews its 'dozens of untextured polygons depicting ass and boobs'
Future? No Thanks! is the latest game to get caught up in Steam's ambiguous content guidelines.

author: PC Gamer
text:
Faker becomes an honorary Korean police officer to help discourage online gambling
A year after Riot embraced "betting sponsorships" for League of Legends, the famous esports pro is now an "ambassador for cyber-gambling prevention."

author: PC Gamer
text:
StarCraft 2 is included in Blizzard's BlizzCon digital goodies, which is more evidence a new game will be announced soon, right?
Is it just me or is Blizzard gearing up to announce the rumored StarCraft shooter?

author: PC Gamer
text:
Microsoft is bringing original Xbox exclusives to PC for the first time, starting with four 'classic games'
Xbox Backward Compatibility on PC, as it's known, is now live.

author: PC Gamer
text:
Star Wars Zero Company's story 'is a linear one from beginning to end', Bit Reactor says, so don't expect branching paths or romance options
"We are excited about pushing the genre forward with a more cinematic approach."

author: PC Gamer
text:
EU court rules that VPNs are 'lawful technical tools' as part of larger copyright judgement regarding The Diary of Anne Frank
Unexpected, but welcome.

author: PC Gamer
text:
Acer and Gigabyte will launch RTX Spark laptops too, but not before Microsoft and Co.
The first batch not including Acer and Gigabyte will launch this fall.

author: PC Gamer
text:
Nearly half of organisations falling victim to ransomware encryption pay up, says report—although half of those often negotiate the payment down first
Bad news, our data is being held hostage for money. Good news, I've got them down to a fairer price.

author: PC Gamer
text:
Halo: Campaign Evolved release times and early access explained
Step back onto the ring 25 years later.

author: PC Gamer
text:
New method teaches AI to make 2D designs 3D and now I'm afraid this will be how the robots learn to build themselves without us
Very cool, though.

author: PC Gamer
text:
Star Wars Zero Company is going all in on Clone customisation, but my favourite armour is restricted to the Deluxe Edition
"We think you’ll be very happy."

author: PC Gamer
text:
OpenAI admits several of its AI models breached testing and hacked into a startup's network by themselves, calling it an 'unprecedented cyber incident'
Containment has been breached.

author: PC Gamer
text:
Someone has already got a regular Nvidia graphics card working on Windows on Arm thanks to RTX Spark drivers, though gaming performance doesn't yet look ideal
Still, it's a nice peek into what is surely to come.

author: PC Gamer
text:
The Elder Scrolls Online is already feeling the impact of Xbox's layoffs, ironically hurting the cash shop
The MMO is already reeling from reduced "team bandwidth".

author: PC Gamer
text:
Nvidia Rubin will 'soak up NAND supply like a sponge absorbs water' says one analyst, thanks to the AI server's new way of using SSDs
It looks like context memory storage (CXM) will guzzle a lot of NAND.

author: PC Gamer
text:
US judge closes the book on first big AI copyright suit, ordering Anthropic to pay $1.5 billion settlement
The end of the story or just the start of a fresh chapter?

author: PC Gamer
text:
Valve puts some elbow grease into Steam Remote Play—maybe one day you won't have to install additional tools to get the best in-home game streaming experience
I want 59.94 frames precisely, waiter.

author: PC Gamer
text:
Steam Deck sales are estimated to have plummeted by around 80% since the massive price hikes earlier this year, back of the napkin maths suggests
A situation nobody wants.

author: PC Gamer
text:
Arc Raiders' matchmaking optimisation is live as Embark warns players they may experience longer queues than usual 'since it's now working harder'
How long would you wait for better teammates?

author: PC Gamer
text:
ZeroSpace is an impressively ambitious RTS-RPG featuring a Helldivers 2-inspired Galactic War, but the streamer pandering is a real bummer
I really don't want to help a content creator become the Galactic Emperor.

author: PC Gamer
text:
Path of Exile 2 players broke the game by summoning 2,000 skeletons and then lured unsuspecting players into the ultimate frame rate shredder
A literal minion army.

author: PC Gamer
text:
Xbox's new VP of engineering quits just 2 months after taking the job
Jared Palmer, who was picked to work directly with CEO Asha Sharma on the division's "most complex" problems, has taken a role at AI company Cognition.

author: PC Gamer
text:
Marathon's experimental PvE mode is live, immediately tripling its daily player count
Cryo Archive is open for all, for a limited time.

author: PC Gamer
text:
Hasbro takes $56 million hit over multiple game cancellations, but it's still talking about how Baldur's Gate 3 is key to its future success
Just a few years after going big on videogames, Hasbro is pulling an Xbox by narrowing its focus on its biggest brands and franchises.

author: PC Gamer
text:
The best farm sims and games like Stardew Valley
Games like Stardew Valley have fully taken root on PC, so now we're thoroughly spoiled for choice on new games to plant parsnips in.

author: PC Gamer
text:
A new friendslop game is already Steam's 12th-most wishlisted game a mere week after it was announced
The takeoff hasn't been without some turbulence, however.
